Operation

Set off from a standstill releasing the clutch gradually, and check whether acceleration is jerky (discontinuous advancement).

Drive the car at constant speed (equal to about 1000 rpm in 4th gear) and, with the clutch pedal release, accelerate rapidly, pressing the accelerator to the floor instantly.

Check whether advancement is discontinuous (jerky).

Problems met

Operation

After disconnecting the clutch pedal from the transmission , check that it travels freely without tight spots or stiffness

Play or stiffness on clutch pedal

CHECK ON CLUTCH RELEASE LEVER AND BEARING (WITH GEARBOX REMOVED)

All OK

Problems met

Operation

After removing the gearbox, check that the lever is not stiff (because of dirty or insufficient lubrication) and that the clutch release bearing runs freely in its seating and shows no signs of damage

Continue to Step 4

The presence of dirt or wear caused by insufficient lubrication does not allow the clutch release bearing to slide correctly

Replace the faulty or damaged parts
